text_annotations.text: 2S servo power / Radxa ZERO 3W / BMI088 + ToF / audio
Excluded: RS485, identification EEPROM, charging, UPS, camera and display. Not released for fabrication.
3.3V GPIO only. Pin 8/10 UART2 also used by boot console: disable console before servo bus operation.
AP64350 pin map: 1 BST, 2 VIN, 3 EN, 4 RT/CLK, 5 FB, 6 COMP, 7 GND, 8 SW; EP is pin 9 and must go to GND (DS41976 p3).
Vout nominal4.984V; fsw nominal500kHz. C303/C304 input and C305/C306 output:22uF/25V X7R1210 each NOMINAL. Use DC-biased model values; C307 remains DNP.
U702 LP38691DT-1.8:3V3 to1V8. C308/C309:2.2uF/50V X7R. R703=47mOhm only in C309 return, never load ground. Include C311 in ESR/loop review.
SMBJ12A: 19.9V clamp at 30.2A, 10/1000us (Vishay88392). AP64350 VIN max40V recommended,42V DC absolute max. Board transient coordination is unverified.
Pin 4 is RT/CLK here but SS on AP64501: symbols and PCB must not be reused across the two parts.

Half-duplex TTL: 1G126 drives DATA from UART2_TX (OE=DXL_DIR high), 1G125 reads DATA into UART2_RX (/OE=DXL_DIR low). R310 pulls DXL_DIR low at boot so the board listens. One bus, two EH sockets, no RS485.
EH pin order: 1=GND, 2=VBAT, 3=DATA. R309 (0R) is the battery-to-servo branch. UART2 is the boot console until disabled in software.
C329/C330: local100nF bypasses from VCC toGND at U801/U802; existing bus polarity and OE logic unchanged.

BMI088 Rev1.9 p52/53: accel SDO1=3V3 (0x19), gyro SDO2=GND (0x68), PS=3V3 selects I2C, CSB2 pin5 is DNC in I2C mode, CSB1 pin14=3V3. Pin 2 is GND despite its NC name. C319/C320 are the local 100nF for VDD/VDDIO.
INT3/INT1 are testpoint/candidate GPIO nets; exact host GPIO assignment remains pending.
R501/R502: 4.7k to 3V3. Start at 100kHz; total bus C <= 240pF. External parallel pull-ups require recalculation.

Mic: electret biased from MICBIAS via R312 2.2k, AC-coupled by C325 into MIC1LP; MIC1LM is AC-coupled to GND by C326. Speaker: PAM8302A from LEFT_LOP through C321, /SD pulled up by R311, 2-pin speaker on J506.
TLV320AIC3104, pinout from the TI IBIS model. I2C 0x18. DVDD(32)=1.8V, IOVDD(7)=3.3V, AVDD(25)=3.3V, DRVDD(18/24)=3.3V. Unused analog inputs left open (see research note).
Codec, electret microphone and mono amplifier are implemented in this design; driver/electrical validation is pending. J504 AC-coupled output is not qualified for low-impedance headphones.
C323=22uF bulk and C328=2.2uF ceramic bypass are local to U803 VDD/GND; nominal values are not guaranteed effective capacitance.
Six rails only (VBATT, SERVO_VBAT, +5V, +3V3, I2C5 SCL/SDA). Measurement access only; no load or protection function.
